firstPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent building sprite for a pixel-art RPG. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create one modest medieval farmer home matching exactly the reference's terracotta house: orthogonal straight front facade, roof visible from elevated game camera, no rotated isometric diamond, flat hand-pixelled shade clusters, muted terracotta roof, cream plaster and dark timber. Single building, centered doorway at bottom center, two small windows and restrained climbing vine. Whole house fits square canvas, narrow transparent margin, no ground patch, no street, no people, no text. Genuine transparent background. Match reference pixel density; not 3D rendered, no microtexture, no volumetric shadows. Readable at 96x96 game pixels. Building base horizontal.
